content.title: National Weather Service
content.text: This AfternoonSunny, with a high near 93. South wind around 20 mph, with gusts as high as 35 mph. TonightA 20 percent chance of showers after 4am. Mostly clear, with a low around 53. South wind 15 to 20 mph becoming south 5 to 10 mph after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 30 mph. FridayA 20 percent chance of showers before 1pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 61. Breezy, with a north wind 20 to 25 mph, with gusts as high as 40 mph. Friday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 41. Northeast wind 10 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph. SaturdaySunny, with a high near 66. Northeast wind 5 to 10 mph becoming south in the afternoon. Saturday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 49. South wind around 10 mph. SundaySunny, with a high near 82. South wind 10 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph. Sunday NightMostly clear, with a low around 64. South wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph. MondayMostly sunny, with a high near 87. South wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph. Monday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 67. South wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph. TuesdayMostly sunny, with a high near 87. South wind 15 to 20 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph.
